H5: Large anti-system civil society movements - v2csantimv - or pro-democracy civil society movements - v2csanmvch_4

```{r}

h5a <- glm(Training_Camp_and_Democratic_Target ~ v2csantimv + WarOnTerror + ColdWar + distance_between_capitals + W, family  = binomial(link = "logit"), data = autocracies_data)
summary(h5a)
exp(coef(h5a))

h5b <- glm(Training_Camp_and_Democratic_Target ~ v2csantimv + WarOnTerror + ColdWar + distance_between_capitals + W, family  = binomial(link = "logit"), data = autocracies_data)
summary(h5b)
exp(coef(h5b))



```
